function.arguments: {"observation": "The email group has a higher proportion of loyal and returning customers, and a lower proportion of new customers compared to paid_search. Similarly, email has fewer customers in the 30-50 and 50+ age groups, and more in the <30 group.", "implication": "The raw difference in conversion rates is confounded by customer segment and age. Since these variables are associated with both the channel and the outcome (conversion), we cannot interpret the raw difference as a causal effect. We must adjust for these imbalances — either by stratifying, standardizing, or using a model. The simplest valid approach is to compute the difference within strata of customer_segment and age_group, then average them (weighted by population size)."}
function.name: note_finding
